text: Compared with the earlier promise, the apparent difference narrows. Isaac is the child of the covenant, the one through whom the nations are to be blessed; and that promise is here turned into a test. The whole scene turns upon the single word _hineni_, "here I am," which Abraham says three times: to God, to Isaac, and to the angel. The word means something different at each utterance, and at each it costs Abraham more than it did when he first answered God.
